prompt: I changed two paragraphs in the memo you checked last week. Check it again before I send it.
context: The earlier run is logged, less than 14 days old, and the earlier version is retrievable.
passes_if: Runs DELTA: the changed sections, every time-sensitive claim in the whole artifact, the brief lens on the whole artifact, and a full rerun of any numeric script. One round. The same request on a contract, after a BLOCKED verdict, or with more than a third of the artifact changed reruns at its normal tier.
fails_if: It credits arithmetic from the earlier run, or runs DELTA on a contract.

phrases: checks the change and credits the logged run for the rest
plus every time-sensitive claim in the whole artifact
plus the brief lens on the whole artifact
DELTA is never available for a contract, a term sheet or paid-against arithmetic
more than a third of the paragraphs, rows or slides
